description: This file defines the main application widget for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game, including the root app widget, homepage layout, and a result banner component. It sets up the MaterialApp, themes, asset precaching, and UI structure with game state integration.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the MaterialApp with theme, title, and home page.

classes.name: GameHomePage
classes.description: Main game screen widget that displays game components like score, board, and reset controls.

classes.name: _ResultBanner
classes.description: A widget to display the game result, indicating win or draw state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for each class: App initializes the app, GameHomePage constructs the game UI, _ResultBanner shows game outcome.
